carrier_line.bell: iPhone and Android phones, paid off monthly if you like. Bell SmartPay spreads a phone's price across 24 months.
carrier_line.virgin-plus: Billed monthly, and most plans include Member Benefits: perks for food, shopping, travel and entertainment at no extra cost.
carrier_line.lucky-mobile: Prepaid: you pay first and use it after. It comes without a credit check or a contract, and runs on the same Bell network.

carrier_short.bell: Phones you can pay off month by month.
carrier_short.virgin-plus: Monthly plans, with Member Benefits on most.

repairs.title: Screens and glass
repairs.text: We fit a new screen or glass when yours is cracked or shattered, on phones and tablets.

repairs.title: Weak batteries
repairs.text: The charge disappears fast, the phone cuts out before it reaches zero, or the battery has started to swell.

repairs.title: Won't charge
repairs.text: Nothing happens when you plug it in, or it charges only when the cable is wedged at an angle.

repairs.title: Lens and back damage
repairs.text: Photos coming out blurry, a lens with a crack in it, or a back panel that's smashed.

repairs.title: Sound problems
repairs.text: Calls sound muffled, or the speaker or microphone has gone quiet.

repairs.title: A wet phone
repairs.text: Power it off straight away and get it to us quickly.

faq.a: Yes, drop in {{ hours_phrase }}. Booking is only for when you'd like us to set a time aside.

faq.q: Does my number move with me?
faq.a: Yes. Your number can move with you to the new provider. Bring a recent bill that shows your account number, plus photo ID in case we need it. Leave the old plan running until the number has moved; that service then closes by itself.

faq.q: Which providers can I sign up with here?
faq.a: Bell, Virgin Plus and Lucky Mobile. T Wireless is a Bell Authorised Retailer: we sell plans and phones from all three, and we arrange Bell internet, TV and a home phone line.

faq.q: Do you repair tablets as well as phones?
faq.a: Yes, tablets and phones alike. Name the model and describe the fault, and the price comes before any work.

faq.q: Can I get in with a wheelchair?
faq.a: Yes, the entrance is wheelchair accessible. If you'd like to check anything else before you come, give us a call.
